claims.anchor:
ds4cc.com's `sitemap.xml` (93 locs) is the
   "should-serve" set for ds4cc.kimi.page.
claims.claim: The live canonical sitemap currently has 93 entries and is the should-serve inventory for the Kimi mirror.
claims.correction: As of 2026-10-21, the live ds4cc.com sitemap contains 96 <loc> entries and remains the should-serve inventory for ds4cc.kimi.page.

claims.claim: Parity of the canonical list reports 19 served and 74 missing Kimi paths.
claims.surface: GET https://ds4cc.com/sitemap.xml; GET all 96 mapped paths on https://ds4cc.kimi.page (trailing / mapped to index.html)
claims.correction: As of 2026-10-21, the live sitemap has 96 canonical locations and the 96 directory-mapped Kimi GETs return 19 HTTP 200 and 77 HTTP 404.

claims.claim: The index-linked omarchy-usage, omegag, and speedrun directory URLs fail on Kimi while their index.html paths serve.
The burnerchrome Kimi index has 15 same-origin link targets and zero non-200 targets.
claims.surface: GET https://burnerchrome.kimi.page/ and its 15 unique same-origin non-fragment href/src targets

claims.claim: The source-history pointer f3d2ecd is the sitemap change adding 75 URLs to the 18-entry list, reaching 93.
claims.surface: GET https://github.com/VeigaPunk/ds4cc-marketplace/commits/main/sitemap.xml; GET https://github.com/VeigaPunk/ds4cc-marketplace/commit/f3d2ecd; GET raw sitemap at 2b5fd57 and 0b1116766de2d9895a3673c88678049b4946cf3c
claims.observation: f3d2ecd commit URL: HTTP 404; reachable history shows 0b1116766de2d9895a3673c88678049b4946cf3c; count outputs: 2b5fd57 loc_count=18 and 0b1116766de2d9895a3673c88678049b4946cf3c loc_count=93.
claims.correction: As of 2026-10-21, the reachable sitemap history shows commit 0b1116766de2d9895a3673c88678049b4946cf3c adding 75 locations (parent 2b5fd57: 18; new tree: 93), while the cited f3d2ecd URL returns 404.
